verse.verse_1: Nay! I swear by this city
verse.verse_2: – this city wherein you have been rendered violable–
verse.verse_3: and I swear by the parent and his offspring:
verse.verse_4: Verily We have created man into toil and hardship.
verse.verse_5: Does he think that no one can overpower him?
verse.verse_6: He says: “I have squandered enormous wealth.”
verse.verse_7: Does he believe that none has seen him?
verse.verse_8: Did We not grant him two eyes,
verse.verse_9: and a tongue and two lips?
verse.verse_10: And did We not show him the two highroads (of good and evil)?
verse.verse_11: But he did not venture to scale the difficult steep.
verse.verse_12: And what do you know what that difficult steep is?
verse.verse_13: It is freeing someone's neck from slavery;
verse.verse_14: or giving food on a day of hunger
verse.verse_15: to an orphan near of kin;
verse.verse_16: or to a destitute lying in dust;
verse.verse_17: and, then besides this, he be one of those who believed, and enjoined upon one another steadfastness and enjoined upon one another compassion.
verse.verse_18: These are the People of the Right Hand.
verse.verse_19: As for those who rejected Our Signs, they are the People of the Left Hand.
verse.verse_20: Upon them shall be a Fire that will hem them in.
